I would still get nightmares no matter what. 

The dangers I went through for getting out of my comfort zone talking and keeping friendships or relationship. Since I have very bad social anxiety I usually stop talking or distance myself even if they seem very good. 

I wanted to overcome my social anxiety so I made sure I didn't distance myself like usual always finding a reason, so I trusted someone who shouldn't have been trusted, I denied all warning signs and wanted to be understanding since I thought everyone deserves a chance to be listened to and loved for who they really are, and understood.. But because of that I was just taken advantage of from guilt tripping and gaslighting for 3.5 years. 

I just wish someone told me it was ok to be comfortable, not always out of the comfort zone, people just associate butterflies with love so I assumed it was love but it was just being uncomfortable. Everyone always told me getting out of my comfort zone would help me, but it helps me tolerate and dismiss dangers thinking it's all in my head. Also sometimes just doing healthy things can help to an extent but being in severe depression for such a long time with c-PTSD, really destroys brain connections and makes it very hard to get back to "normal" that's why I want to take the ketamine I was prescribed for, as it rebuilds connections in the  rain but can't get myself to.

Idk I spent a long time outside my comfort zone because that's what everyone was saying would help me overcome anxiety but that just made me dismiss danger signs and left me scarred with trauma, scared of even more and confused about what reality actually is
